paper.title_en: Anomalous Charge Conjugation and Parity in (2 + 1)-Dimensional Relativistic Hydrodynamics
paper.abstract_en: We develop a hydrostatic and first-order constitutive description of a mixed anomaly involving $U(1)_Q$, $U(1)_F$, charge conjugation (acting only on $U(1)_Q$), and parity in $2+1$ dimensions, characterized by a mutual Chern–Simons level $k_{QF} = \frac{1}{2} \pmod{\mathbb{Z}}$. Using the established multi-charge anomaly sector, we make explicit that this response is odd under $C$ and $P$ separately but even under $CP$, specify a global inflow representative, and derive the equilibrium cross-charge response, including $\frac{\partial n_Q}{\partial B_F} = \frac{\partial n_F}{\partial B_Q} = \frac{1}{4\pi} \pmod{\frac{1}{2\pi}}$. An analytic neutral-fluid example shows that this response is nonzero while the source-free hydrodynamic poles are unaffected.
